conclusion: Removing the remaining per-layer compact-WMMA wmma_total scalar D2H synchronization does not clear the gfx1151 128K lifecycle failure. A cached 4K/1 smoke is exact and the recorder-enabled 128K warmup completes at 507.552 prefill / 28.100 decode tok/s, but measured prefill 1 enters the same persistent 100%-activity, 2.9-GHz, low-power state. The last retired marker certifies all work through token 36864. Without the per-layer readback, the host rapidly queues all 40 layers for chunk [36864,40960), enters the next chunk and publishes its embedding checkpoint, then stops in the following synchronous token-id H2D boundary. The scalar readback and metadata copies therefore act as observation/fencing points but are not necessary to trigger the failure. Chunk markers still cannot identify the exact last retired user dispatch or exclude one queued nonterminating kernel, but the shifting chunk/layer/host boundary across three captures remains more consistent with timing-sensitive user-queue/fence lifecycle no-progress than with one deterministic layer location.
